== Notes ==
* The energy loss can be split between multiple [[character]]s maintaining the same enchantment on one character. Two characters with 8 Protection Prayers will each lose 2 energy per hit. Three characters at 13 Protection Prayers will each only lose 1 energy per hit. Two characters at 13 Protection Prayers will lose 2 and 1 energy, respectively. The first to cast takes the larger energy burden on an odd split. If characters are at differing [[attribute]] ranks of Protection Prayers, the lowest rank is used.
**If the enchantment is split up so that each [[bonder]] will lose 1 energy, then each of the bonders can cast [[Life Bond]] on the character that is the target of Protective Bond, and then [[Balthazar's Spirit]] on themselves to cover all of the energy cost, and maintain Protective Bond as long as it isn't stripped.  However, Life Bond only splits up damage from [[attack]]s, so 1 energy will still be lost for each [[packet]] of damage from non-attack damage.  As long as the non-attack damage isn't reduced to zero, 1 energy can usually still be gained from [[Essence Bond]].
* If more than one character is maintaining this enchantment and one character runs out of energy, all other characters stop maintaining the enchantment.

== Trivia ==
* Before it was [[nerf]]ed, this skill was the backbone to a [[55 Monk]] build for [[farming]] [[the Underworld]]. According to [[Isaiah Cartwright]], [[User_talk:Isaiah_Cartwright/Izzy_Talk_Archive_1#Essence_Bond_question...|this skill was nerfed]] not solely because it was overpowered in [[Player versus Environment|PvE]], but because of a recursion [[bug]] that could crash [[ArenaNet]] servers.
* During the beta, this skill was known as ''Mantle of Protection''<ref>http://pc.gamespy.com/pc/guild-wars/560583p2.html</ref>.
